rationale: Zone 1 set to 81.5% of protected line impedance (26.39 Ω) for underreach. Zone 2 covers protected line plus 55% of shortest backup line (L_BC). Zone 3 covers protected line plus 122.5% of longest backup line (L_BD) while staying well below the 121 Ω load encroachment limit. All timing delays are within specified coordination windows and nondecreasing.
